claims.title: Wave control of a sustained zonal-mode phase, reduced model

quoted_fields.interface: The source constructs torque-neutral signed wave forcing and a conditional stochastic phase-control model for positioning a naturally sustained protective zonal flow. Its exact model power can scale with phase-restoration demand rather than full amplitude damping, while the actual wave-to-mode interface and matched confinement benefit remain open.
quoted_fields.failure: Source-reported completed reduced-physics construction and original exploratory script; no demonstrated plasma controller, measured confinement gain, independently acquired scientific audit, novelty determination or practical advantage. Turbulence-sustained amplitude, soft phase, programmable deposition, effective coupling and phase diffusion are supplied model inputs. Actual antenna-to-wave-to-mode susceptibility, transient dressing momentum, nonlinear heat-flux payoff and equally informed matched-control comparison remain unearned. Script preserved without execution or repair; all existing holds remain.
